skill.name: set-up-shopify-chatgpt-ads-poas-bidding
skill.description: POAS (profit on ad spend) bidding for Shopify in ChatGPT Ads. Use this skill when a Shopify merchant wants ChatGPT Ads to bid on profit instead of revenue: switching from ROAS to POAS, choosing a target ROAS on profit, or campaigns that hit their ROAS target and still lose money. It sends profit to ChatGPT Ads through the OpenAI Conversions API, to optimise on its value. Also covers ROAS (revenue) bidding. It works through Product Metrics, so use it even when Product Metrics is never mentioned. Not for new customer, returning customer or LTV bidding: each has its own skill, as do other store platforms and ad channels.
skill.summary: Use Product Metrics to verify Shopify profit tracking and plan a move from revenue bidding to profit bidding in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown or routine documentation, but the workflow directs authenticated tool calls, can fetch live instructions, and offers an unpinned installer command. Key handling and consent instructions need clarification before use. No evidence of prompt injection or malicious data transfer was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The skill allows a conversion API key to pass through the assistant.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the key exception and direct users to enter the key only in the verified Product Metrics settings form.

remediation.issue: The setup enables tracking without a clear account of which consent choices allow which data to be sent.
remediation.suggestion: Document each consent requirement and show the destination and data fields before enabling tracking. Test both accepted and declined consent before going live.

remediation.issue: Authenticated setup and order operations lack consistent scope and approval checks.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the selected store, workspace, and pixel before handling private data. Use only necessary test-order fields and require confirmation before each setup change or retry.

remediation.issue: The optional installer command is unpinned, and fallback workflows can rely on mutable remote instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill revision. Prefer bundled references and verify the origin and revision of any remote fallback before acting on it.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Instructions for Conversion API Keys
semantic_findings.description: The main workflow allows the agent to ask for an OpenAI Conversions API key and pass it to a command. The connection guide forbids pasting the key into chat. A key passed through the assistant could appear in tool records even when it is not repeated in a response.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The credential exception and the chat prohibition are both explicit. No evidence of an actual key disclosure was found.

semantic_findings.title: Unclear Consent Requirements for Customer Data Sharing
semantic_findings.description: The connection guide leaves event sending enabled and documents marketing consent for events that can contain shopper identifiers and IP addresses. The bidding guide adds analytics consent and describes sending opted-out events. It does not explain how those choices interact with the marketing consent requirement.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guides list different consent controls without explaining how they combine. This shows a documentation gap, not evidence that the service bypasses consent.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopify Profit Bidding in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A Shopify campaign can meet its revenue target while losing money. Use Product Metrics to verify profit tracking and plan a switch to profit-based bidding in ChatGPT Ads.
actual_capabilities: Checks Product Metrics setup status through the CLI or MCP and identifies unfinished steps.
Explains how to connect a Shopify store and a ChatGPT Ads pixel through Product Metrics.
Identifies the Shopify product costs and additional fees needed to calculate contribution margin.
Guides the user through verifying that a consented test order delivered a profit event.
Explains how to choose a starting profit-based target from the campaign's current profit on ad spend.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics access and a connected Shopify store. Shopify app permissions and subscription approval are manual.
You must create and select the campaign conversion yourself in ChatGPT Ads Manager.
Orders with unknown costs do not send profit values. Losses are sent as zero, and later refunds do not revise ChatGPT Ads events.
This workflow does not configure new customer, returning customer, or lifetime value bidding.

use_cases.title: Check readiness for profit bidding
use_cases.description: Find out whether your Shopify store, costs, and ChatGPT Ads destination are ready for a profit conversion.

use_cases.title: Plan a single-campaign switch
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit targets and prepare to switch one campaign after verifying its profit event.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing profit values
use_cases.description: Check whether missing costs, consent settings, or delivery problems explain why a test order has no profit event.

prompt_templates.title: Understand profit bidding
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the difference between revenue and profit bidding for my Shopify store. Tell me what needs to be ready before I switch.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are evaluating profit bidding for the first time.

prompt_templates.title: Review my setup status
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm my intended Shopify store and Product Metrics workspace before checking setup. List what is complete and what I need to do. Do not change settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have an existing Product Metrics workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a missing profit event
prompt_templates.prompt: My test order shows revenue but no profit event. Help me check costs, consent, and pixel delivery without showing customer details or changing settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: You placed a test order that did not produce the expected event.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a profit bidding pilot
prompt_templates.prompt: My campaign has a current profit on ad spend of 1.5. Suggest a starting target and a verification plan. Explain how missing costs, losses, or refunds might distort the reported result. Leave all campaign settings unchanged.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have enough profit data to compare a pilot with your existing campaign.

output_examples.input: The destination says the setup test passed, but I cannot find the profit event in Ads Manager.
output_examples.output: The setup test validates the connection but does not appear in Ads Manager. Verify the consent settings and costs, then place a paid test order. Wait for the profit event before creating the conversion.

output_examples.input: My current profit on ad spend is 1.5. What target should I start with?
output_examples.output: Consider 150% as a starting profit-based target for one campaign. Review it after a few weeks and compare it with store-level profit. Orders with unknown costs send no profit value, and orders sold at a loss report zero profit.

output_examples.input: My paid test order shows revenue, but product costs are missing.
output_examples.output: Check the Shopify variant costs and the configured fallback in Product Metrics. Confirm the additional costs are active before placing another test order.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace, store, and pixel before setup. Enter conversion API keys only in the verified settings form.
Verify complete costs and test how the storefront consent banner affects what is sent before enabling live tracking.
Start with one campaign and compare reported results with actual contribution margin after refunds and advertising costs.
anti_patterns: Copying a revenue-based ROAS target directly to profit bidding.
Treating a successful connection test as proof that a profit event is visible in Ads Manager.
Sharing conversion API keys or identifiable customer records in chat.

faq.question: What is POAS?
faq.answer: Profit on ad spend compares your contribution profit before advertising costs with what you spend on ads.

faq.question: Which event should I select for profit bidding?
faq.answer: Create a conversion for pm_order_profit once Ads Manager receives it. Select that conversion yourself and optimize the campaign for its value.

faq.question: What do I need before I start?
faq.answer: You need a Product Metrics workspace, a connected Shopify store with an active subscription, and access to ChatGPT Ads Manager.

faq.question: Why does an order show revenue but no profit?
faq.answer: A required cost may be missing. Check Shopify variant costs, the cost fallback, and additional costs in Product Metrics.

faq.question: Will the setup send earlier orders or update refunded conversions?
faq.answer: No. The integration does not import historical orders or revise ChatGPT Ads events after later refunds.

faq.question: Where should I enter my Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Enter it in the OpenAI Conversions API settings in Product Metrics. Do not share it in chat.
